# LinkSentinel

> AI-powered URL shortener with an agentic threat shield (reputation scanner, CNN inspection hooks, preview agent) and RAG analytics over click data. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis, Celery and Docker by Nikhil Chary Sriramoju.

## Pages
- [Home](%SITE%/): overview
- [Threat Shield](%SITE%/threat-shield): Score any URL for phishing signals.
- [Console](%SITE%/console): Dashboard, RAG chat over click data, API keys.
- [Security](%SITE%/security): Agents, SSRF guard, rate limiting, RBAC, hashing.
- [Roadmap](%SITE%/roadmap): Access roles and what ships next.
- [About](%SITE%/about): The builder: Nikhil Chary Sriramoju.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Nikhil-creat/linksentinel): code and README
